status: PROPOSAL - research data only. This file is NOT authoritative simulation state and NOT renderer presentation data. It does not finalise a runtime schema. Canonical settlement/location identities (RFC 4122 UUIDv5, ADR-0009) are minted only by the atlas pipeline at integration time; the proposedId values here are research handles, not canonical IDs.
subject: R-16 historical settlement roster, batch 7 (regions 14,15,16)
batchScope: North Africa (Punic Africa, Numidia, Tripolitania), Cyrenaica, Egypt & western oases
coordinateConvention: WGS84 decimal degrees, approximate representative points for the ancient site (not the modern town unless noted). Precision does not imply archaeological accuracy and is not a surveyed building location.
idScheme: proposedId = r16-afr-<slug> (region 14), r16-cyr-<slug> (region 15), r16-egy-<slug> (region 16); slug region-scoped to avoid homonyms. Stable, human-readable, non-canonical.
methodNote: Records compiled from independent evidence (primary literary/administrative sources, archaeology, gazetteer leads). Game/mod faction names are discovery leads only and never authorities. Every coordinate is a representative point with explicit location confidence; where only a broad location is known coordinate is coarse or null. Political authority recorded only where supported. All literary sources are later than 278 BCE and dated in each record; evidence for continuity, not contemporary snapshot.
sourceAuditNote: Pleiades gazetteer identifiers recorded only as 'to be confirmed'. Coordinates are approximate representative points, not surveyed locations. Literary sources (Polybius, Diodorus, Strabo, Pliny, Ptolemy, Livy) are later than 278 BCE; no contemporary sources were asserted. Manual confirmation of Pleiades ids and site coordinates remains an integration prerequisite.
politicalContext278Bce: Region 14: Carthage dominates Punic Africa, western Sicily, Sardinia, Tripolitanian emporia (including Syrtis ports), and exerts control over Libyan/Moorish hinterland communities; Numidia is a Berber kingdom (later Massinissa). Region 15: Cyrenaica Ptolemaic under Magas (half-brother of Ptolemy II). Region 16: Egypt Ptolemaic under Ptolemy II Philadelphus (Alexandria capital).
duplicateGuard: None of these records reproduce settlements from other batches.
coverageNote: Region 14 reached 40 (added Pupput as attested Punic settlement). Region 16 trimmed by 5 to meet target of 31. Region 15 at 9. Total 80 records; no invented settlements.
